assumptions.income: household gross income at band midpoint (over_100k uses 130000); split 60/40 between adults in a couple
assumptions.income_type: employed -> employment income; self_employed -> self-employment income; retired -> private pension income; unemployed and not_working_other -> no earned income (band not applied)
assumptions.age: representative age per band: 17, 21, 30, 42, 57, 70; partner same age
assumptions.children: none -> no children; under_5 -> one child aged 3; school_age -> one child aged 10; adult_dependant -> treated as none
assumptions.rent: private_rent: 15600/yr single without children, 21600/yr otherwise; social_rent: 9000/yr; owners and other: 0 (mortgage interest not modelled)
assumptions.student: no effect modelled (student finance is outside the tax-benefit model)
assumptions.other_adults: household type 'other' modelled as a single adult; other adults' incomes not included
assumptions.benefits: household assumed to claim Universal Credit and Child Benefit if entitled
assumptions.policy: current law as encoded in policyengine-uk 2.98.0
